title: Time-reversal inference with uncertain observation channels: code and compact supporting data
description: Scientific code and compact supporting data for the paper by Dev D. Goyal. The release contains all current saved decision rows, complete summary and figure support tables, and metadata for 20,800 current study records. Raw trajectories and large numerical certificates remain local. Original code uses the MIT License. Original data and documents use CC BY 4.0. Third-party files retain their own terms.
